summary: Implemented every stub in cookiecutter/cli.py (version message, extra-context validation, --list-installed, the main command with replay/accept-hooks handling and exception reporting), cookiecutter/replay.py (get_file_name, dump, load with type and key checks), and cookiecutter/zipfile.py (unzip for local files and URLs, with cache prompt, password handling and InvalidZipRepository errors). The last full-suite run gave 179 passed and 188 failed; tests/replay and tests/zipfile now pass, and the remaining tests/test_cli.py failures all need project generation through the unimplemented main.cookiecutter in main.py.
